name: submit_followup
description: Records in a single request how the plot is doing, what the farmer did, whether it worked and when they noticed the change. Call it only once, when you have the four answers.

status_reported.description: How the plot is doing: worse, same, improved, resolved (the problem is gone), unknown (they don't know)

user_statement.description: Short summary, in the farmer's words, of what they said

actions_taken.description: What the farmer did on the plot. Empty if they did nothing or don't know

action_worked.description: Whether what they did worked: yes, no, partial (partly) or unknown (they don't know)

change_noticed_days_ago.description: How many days ago they noticed the change. Omit if they don't know or there was no change. Never use 0 to mean 'I don't know'
